capabilities: Explore the vault in an interactive 3D or flat graph with touch and keyboard controls
Record time-lapse videos of vault growth by creation, modification or date properties
Check link health and suggest missing links between notes
Color folders in the graph and the file explorer, with saved camera and filter views
Show live AI agent reads and writes via an activity log
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Works offline; optional AI-activity reads require an external hook script (Node.js 18+) writing to .cortex/activity.jsonl.
intentEvidence: Uses your graph view settings – color groups and path filters of the core graph view are applied
problem: Obsidian's core graph view is a flat, mostly passive visualization with no time-lapse, link diagnostics, or folder-based navigation for large vaults.

requires.name: Claude Code (optional, for AI activity reads)

summary: 3D graph view with glowing nodes that adds live updates, time-lapse video export, folder coloring, link health checks and shortest-path finding.
